name: @svgo-mbt/app
description: svgo.mbt website: MoonBit (Rabbita) app with Tailwind CSS v4 and a Remotion hero animation

scripts.motion:render:light: remotion render motion/src/index.ts Hero public/hero.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 22 --props='{"theme":"light"}' && remotion still motion/src/index.ts Hero public/hero-poster.jpg --frame 150 --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 85 --props='{"theme":"light"}'
scripts.motion:render:dark: remotion render motion/src/index.ts Hero public/hero-dark.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 22 --props='{"theme":"dark"}' && remotion still motion/src/index.ts Hero public/hero-dark-poster.jpg --frame 150 --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 85 --props='{"theme":"dark"}'
